name: delivery-status-classification
description: Only HTTP 202 is acceptance (C8 kept): 200, 201, 204, and every other 4xx drop the batch for good; 408, 429, 5xx, a transport error, and a timeout queue it for retry. Delivery's own collector_request reports (Dart 0.11.1) are events like any other: they join batches and take request ids, so a step may answer a batch of reports; the step notes name the request each step answers or sends, and the scenario ends with no request in flight.

steps.note: 200 is not 202: dropped, never retried (C8 kept)
408, 429, and 5xx queue the batch for retry
